findings.evidence: Presentation.lean:116-130 `structure WedderburnEndomorphismPresentation (K : Type v) (A : Type u) [CommSemiring K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] … equiv : A ≃ₐ[K] ∀ i, Matrix … ᵐᵒᵖ`; contrast Presentation.lean:77 `WedderburnAlgebraPresentation`, :103 `SplitWedderburnAlgebraPresentation`, :96 `FiniteWedderburnAlgebraPresentation`, all algebra-level and all carrying `Algebra` in the name, versus :61 `WedderburnPresentation (R : Type u) [Ring R]` with `equiv : R ≃+* …`.
findings.fix: Rename to `WedderburnEndomorphismAlgebraPresentation` (Mathlib's corresponding theorem is `exists_algEquiv_pi_matrix_end_mulOpposite`, so `WedderburnEndMulOppositeAlgebraPresentation` is also defensible), and rename the choice function `IsSemisimpleRing.wedderburnEndomorphismPresentation` (line 372, with its private `nonempty_…` at line 364) and the module-docstring entries at lines 17 and 33 to match.
findings.issue: `WedderburnEndomorphismPresentation K A` is an algebra presentation (`[CommSemiring K] [Algebra K A]`, `equiv : A ≃ₐ[K] …`, and it forgets to `WedderburnAlgebraPresentation` at line 245), but its name drops `Algebra`, which in this file is precisely what separates the ring-level `WedderburnPresentation` (line 61) from the algebra-level `WedderburnAlgebraPresentation`/`SplitWedderburnAlgebraPresentation`/`FiniteWedderburnAlgebraPresentation`. The name reads as the ring-level analogue of `WedderburnPresentation`.

summary: Names and (absent) notation are otherwise conventional and consistent with the roadmap-pinned terminology and the adjacent Blocks.lean precedent. The one defect is the endomorphism-form presentation, which is algebra-level but named without `Algebra`, contradicting the ring/algebra naming distinction the rest of the file establishes.
